title: The diner re-cooks: ecology works travel as provenance-locked Quick Snacks
editorial_proposition: A standing reuse relation transcribed retroactively (2026-07-17): six works of the ecology — one Ensemble premiere, five Meridian instruments — are re-served on data-snack.com as Quick Snacks whose per-file provenance frontmatter (supplier, work, gauntlet, inspected) is a delivery slip that predates this ledger; the transport automation exists but is deliberately only part-armed; one open correction is recorded (wing language in the supplier template). The relation is open and running.

proposition_author.note: retroactive transcription commissioned by Frank (2026-07-17); lean record — the nightly scribe appends from here

status.statusLine: open/standing — 14 works re-cooked (frozen since run #55, 2026-09-02, commit e03327a: STILL DARK, ALL AT ONCE, NOT YET). The 34-day silent stall (day 1-34) broke once by accident at run #55 (an unrelated LLM-availability outage routed the hard-failing upstream work to SKIP instead of FAIL) and resumed the very next run (#56, day 36); since then the two-item failing signature (field-research's 2026-07-26-unable-to-ring-its-own-bell, 'no sources cited', joined from run #57 by studio's 2026-09-03-what-the-number-measured, same check) has held unbroken through run #63 (2026-09-10, day 43) — a further extraction-service outage recurred twice more (runs #58 and #60) without ever again bypassing the exit-code guard. No commit has landed on main since e03327a; the discarded backlog (built in CI, never committed) stands at six items (the-second-reader, a native-speaker correction, THE SAME NUMBER TWICE, and corrections to all three already-published snacks); cook automation still scheduled and still firing daily. Separately, all three ecology practices replaced their own PROTOCOL.md on 2026-08-30 under the architect-set 'research ecology v3' rebuild, and frankbueltge.de's own v3 site rebuild moved substantial wording (recorded at ji-2026-001) and datavism.org retired its field-sync mirror outright on 2026-09-08 (recorded at enc-2026-003) — both checked and confirmed to touch none of this fixture's own tracked paths; five open corrections stand as before (wing-language; one-tap's withdrawn source premiere never re-cooked; the recurring silent re-voicing pattern on native-speaker and split-seal; the original silent-stall failure mode; the three 2026-09-02 snacks now stale against their own since-corrected sources).
